description: Optional JSON overrides for the GaMMA association interface. Unspecified values use interface defaults.

common_fields.ncpu: positive integer, capped by available CPUs
common_fields.min_picks_per_eq: integer minimum total picks per event
common_fields.min_p_picks_per_eq: integer minimum P picks per event
common_fields.min_s_picks_per_eq: integer minimum S picks per event

merge: Overrides are recursively merged with defaults; nested fields not supplied remain unchanged.
